answers.core: This is a particular need for core functions to solidify GUI mechanics offered by the engine.
answers.workaround:
At the moment I have to have all important buttons from each page in "FocusGroup" + group of it's own page.
Use singleton for focusing logic.
Get all buttons in "FocusGroup".
Parse buttons in "FocusGroup" to get their page group and create a dictionary with their pages as key.
Implement logic that tracks opened pages.
In singleton track _unhandled_input() actions that are "ui_direction". (I'd appreciate way to do that with fever lines, now I do if for each action).
Then trigger function for finding a button from the needed page and focus it.
Like a miracle it triggers grab_focus() on the button every time but it doesn't happen when one of the buttons is already in focus.
